title: Made this while messing around with Attie
author: ConferenceWooden6913
selftext:
This is one of several games I created while messing around with [attie.ai](http://attie.ai). Each day, it generates a new isometric pipe-rotating puzzle to play. If you log in with your BlueSky account, you can save your streak and share your results. 

The picture is taken directly from the game -- I just cropped out the surrounding website elements.

The premise is simple enough that it's been mostly smooth sailing so far. There were a few hiccups with solving the level and the BlueSky integration, but as far as I can tell those were fixed. If anything comes up during tomorrow's puzzle I'll make sure to fix it.

[https://singing-spry-stork.attie.site](https://singing-spry-stork.attie.site)
